purpose: Propuestas visuales para revisión; sin implementación de código

prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a finished, high-resolution mobile UI design presentation for BLOOMI, a Colombian blood donation app. This is a visual proposal only, not code. Output one landscape contact sheet containing the requested full-height mobile screens, all upright front-facing, same scale, aligned tops and bottoms, no perspective, no overlapping phones, no cropping, no photorealistic devices. Large readable screens, ample gutters on a very pale rose presentation background, small descriptive Spanish screen captions above them. UI must be precise and readable, not a rough sketch.
LOCKED DESIGN SYSTEM FOR ALL SHEETS: brand blood red #DC3545, deeper red #C82333, white cards, very pale pink/white background #FFF9FA, slate text #2B3648. Small SECONDARY PASTEL accents only: mint #DDF3EA, lavender #EEE7FA, butter yellow #FFF0CC, peach #FFE4D6, pale rose #FAD9DF. Red is unmistakably the principal brand color. Do NOT substitute a purple or blue primary. Reference synthesis: organic red-to-pale-pink wavy header boundaries from the user's red donor profile example; white circular avatar overlapping the wave with a small red blood-type droplet badge; generous white breathing space and restrained topographic contour lines in red onboarding headers; friendly rounded humanist typography resembling Nunito with bold 26-30px titles and 15-16px body; soft tactile rounded cards and pastel icon tiles from the finance references, but no bank cards, currencies or financial content; subtle soft shadows and thin rose-tinted dividers, 20-28px card radii, 14px input/button radii. Tasteful occasional tiny clay-like 3D illustrations (heart, blood drop, hospital, gift, robot) using red and pastel accents, restrained and supporting content, never huge generic stock art. CONSISTENT visual identity and spacing across every screen. Spanish copy, sentence case, no lorem ipsum, no unnecessary all-caps labels. Avoid neon colors, noisy gradients, fake data claims, invented appointments, automatic donor eligibility, invented notification system or social login. All example personal information and counts are illustrative.
MAIN TAB NAVIGATION ONLY on authenticated top-level screens: floating white translucent capsule, soft thin border and shadow, 5 equally spaced ICONS ONLY in exact order home / location / ROBOT / gift / heart, robot exactly centered. Selected icon in a pale rose circular inset with a red glyph. No visible labels. Leave bottom padding so content remains visible above the capsule. Forms and access screens use back navigation, NOT this capsule. Main Home header ONLY: profile icon at left | text 'Bloomi' centered WITHOUT logo graphic | logout icon at right. This header scrolls with Home content. Other main tabs have their own title and no repeated Bloomi/profile/logout header.

SHEET 1 OF 4. Exactly FOUR screens side by side with captions '01 Bienvenida', '02 Iniciar sesión', '03 Crear cuenta', '04 Recuperar acceso'.
1 Welcome: generous red upper 45% area with very subtle contour-line pattern, small existing brand concept of a red open droplet embracing a heart represented white on red, small friendly 3D heart/drop illustration; organic wave into white lower area. Large dark heading 'Tu donación puede cambiar una historia.' Short line 'Conecta con centros y acompaña tu camino como donante.' Primary red 'Crear mi cuenta', secondary outlined 'Ya tengo una cuenta'. Friendly and polished.
2 Login: smaller red wave header, white card/body. Title 'Qué bueno verte', email and password fields, eye icon, '¿Olvidaste tu contraseña?', red 'Iniciar sesión', link 'Crear cuenta'. No social login.
3 Register: matching header smaller to fit form, title 'Únete a Bloomi', visible fields 'Tipo de documento' dropdown, 'Número de documento', 'Correo electrónico', 'Contraseña', hint 'Mínimo 10 caracteres'. Primary 'Crear cuenta', secondary 'Ya tengo una cuenta'. Do not add personal name fields here since those belong to the next step.
4 Recovery request: compact wave header and small pastel envelope/lock illustration. 'Recupera tu acceso', explanatory one-line copy, email input, primary 'Enviar enlace', secondary 'Volver a iniciar sesión'. No tabs on any of these four screens.

SHEET 2 OF 4. Exactly FOUR screens side by side: captions '05 Datos personales', '06 Ficha médica', '07 Cuestionario de salud', '08 Revisa tu correo'. All are forms/stack screens WITHOUT bottom tab capsule.
5 Personal info: back chevron, title 'Datos personales', compact red wave hero with white circular initial avatar and small O+ blood badge, step indicator 'Paso 1 de 2'. Form content on white cards with readable grouped fields: 'Primer nombre', 'Segundo nombre', 'Primer apellido', 'Segundo apellido', birth date, blood type, gender, department, city; address and phone optional as smaller lower fields. For this LONG form show a realistic scrollable viewport with the core fields and a visible sticky primary 'Guardar y continuar', NOT squeezed tiny text. Can show lower fields beyond viewport as natural scroll hint.
6 Medical: back navigation, 'Ficha médica', 'Paso 2 de 2', mint privacy badge 'Información privada', three generous multiline white field cards 'Medicamentos', 'Condiciones', 'Alergias', realistic short values 'Ninguno', 'Ninguna registrada', 'Penicilina'. Review checkbox and red 'Guardar ficha médica'. Tiny note that the health team determines eligibility, no medical recommendations.
7 Questionnaire: back, 'Cuestionario de salud', pale lavender progress indicator, friendly heading 'Cuéntanos cómo te sientes', sample neutral question cards with 'Sí'/'No' pill choices; do not diagnose. 3 readable cards, selected pills red, small pastel category tile; primary 'Guardar respuestas'. Show scroll architecture and clear hierarchy.
8 Email confirmation: matching compact red wave header, restrained 3D envelope/check illustration in mint/pink. 'Revisa tu correo', copy 'Si existe una cuenta con este correo, recibirás un enlace para recuperar tu acceso.' Subdued resend button 'Reenviar en 00:45', red 'Volver a iniciar sesión'. These are design states of existing flows, not new features.

SHEET 3 OF 4. Exactly THREE LARGE screens side by side: captions '09 Inicio', '10 Centros', '11 Asistente'. All have same 5-icon floating capsule, respectively home/location/ROBOT selected.
9 HOME is the flagship. Scrollable top red header with profile icon left, text Bloomi centered ONLY text, logout right. Below in red region show 'Hola, Mateo' on right. Organic wave into pale rose lower background, large white circular initial avatar overlapping wave at left, small red O+ droplet badge attached at lower right of avatar, directly inspired by the user's own donor-profile reference. NO fake profile photo picker. Two readable impact tiles '4 Donaciones' and '320 Puntos', one rose and one butter-yellow pastel. Primary red donation action card 'Tu próximo paso', 'Encuentra dónde donar', white 'Buscar centros'. Below 'Tu salud' with two calm action rows 'Ficha médica' with mint icon and 'Cuestionario' with lavender icon, statuses 'Actualizada' and 'Pendiente'. White cards, restrained 3D drop/heart detail on main action, no clutter. Content cannot collide with bottom nav.
10 CENTERS: red-accent wave/soft white upper region, title 'Centros de donación', short subtitle, rounded search 'Buscar ciudad o institución'. Three white institution cards with pastel hospital icon tiles: 'Hemocentro Distrital' / 'Bogotá · Cundinamarca' / 'Carrera 7 # 32-12'; 'Banco de Sangre Medellín' / 'Medellín · Antioquia' / 'Calle 50 # 40-20'; 'Centro de Hemoterapia' / 'Cali · Valle del Cauca'. Thin dividers, hospital/map-pin details. No fake map, distance, appointments or booking buttons. Small note 'Confirma horarios directamente con la institución.' 
11 CHAT: 'Asistente Bloomi', friendly tiny clay-style red/white robot with pastel mint highlights. Short label 'Ayuda guiada', readable conversational white and pale-rose message bubbles: greeting 'Hola, ¿en qué te ayudo?', user bubble '¿Cómo uso mis puntos?', assistant bubble explaining the Canjes tab in simple language. Suggested chips 'Buscar centros', 'Mis puntos', 'Mi perfil'. It is local guided app help, NOT AI or medical advice, no claim of online connection or typing. Bottom robot tab selected.

12 REWARDS: authenticated screen with shared five-icon capsule, gift selected. Header 'Canjes', subtitle 'Pequeños detalles por tu gran gesto.' Red main balance card with subtle contour/wave and gift icon 'Tu saldo' / '320 puntos'. Rounded catalogue cards with pastel icon/illustration tiles, title, short description and cost: 'Botella reutilizable' 250 pts primary 'Canjear'; 'Café para compartir' 400 pts muted 'Faltan 80 pts'; a previously redeemed example with clear mint 'Canjeado' badge. Content is illustrative, no currency and no bank-card visuals.

Beautiful pale mint confirmation notice with check icon, text 'La institución confirma cada donación'. White 'Historial reciente' panel with fine rose dividers and small red timeline dots: 'Hemocentro Distrital', 'Bogotá · 12 oct 2026'; 'Banco de Sangre Medellín', 'Medellín · 10 sep 2026'. Small pastel 3D gift, 'Confirmar canje', selected item 'Botella reutilizable', '250 puntos', clear row 'Saldo después del canje: 70 puntos'. Strong red primary 'Sí, canjear', secondary 'Ahora no'. Bottom sheet respects home indicator and obscures navigation as a true modal. No payment fields or monetary currency.
